cards.title: Positional BLQ Handling Logic
cards.claim: BLQ values are categorized by their position in the concentration-time profile: 'first' (up to first non-BLQ), 'middle' (between first and last non-BLQ), 'last' (after last non-BLQ), or relative to Tmax ('before.tmax', 'after.tmax'). Each category can be independently configured to 'drop', 'keep', or set to a specific numeric value.
conditions: Concentration values are considered BLQ if they are 0.
NA values are handled by `clean.conc.na` before BLQ logic is applied.
The method for handling NA can affect which points are subsequently classified as BLQ or 'middle'.
required_inputs: BLQ handling strategy (`conc.blq`): scalar or list with keys 'first', 'middle', 'last', 'before.tmax', 'after.tmax'
limitations: BLQ is defined strictly as 0 in this implementation.
The output depends on the order of operations: NA handling precedes BLQ handling.
Does not specify statistical imputation methods beyond setting to a fixed number or dropping.
cards.downstream_use: Preprocessing step for NCA or compartmental modeling to ensure consistent handling of censored data before parameter estimation.

note: Method/reference scope retained; source identity is available in original evidence.
